query: For my 53-year-old female inpatient: among female inpatients 48–58 with diabetes and heart failure, what are prevalence (%) of subcutaneous GLP‑1 starts in first 24h vs final 12h?
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.charttime BETWEEN a.intime AND a.intime + INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.charttime BETWEEN a.intime + INTERVAL '24 hours' AND a.intime + INTERVAL '36 hours' THEN 1 END), 0) AS proportion FROM transfers t JOIN admissions a ON t.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND CAST(p.anchor_age AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 48 AND 58 AND p.had_diabetes = 'Y' AND p.had_heart_failure = 'Y' AND t.itemid = 757071;
